description: List the form fields (AcroForm) of a PDF: names, types, options, current values and per-field maxLength where declared, plus a fillTemplate object ready to pass to pdf_fill and a hasXFA flag (hybrid AcroForm/XFA inputs lose their XFA layer when filled). A PDF with no fillable form returns count 0. Read-only: the PDF is fetched or read but never modified. pdf_fill rejects unknown field names and over-length values; this tool lists the names and the maxLength values it checks against.

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it).

pdf_path.description: PDF source: a path to a .pdf file inside the allowed directories (PDFOPS_ROOT, default the working directory), an https:// URL, or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI. A URL or data URI works when this server runs remotely (Smithery, hosted gateways), where local paths do not exist.

name: pdf_inspect

count.description: Number of form fields found; 0 when the PDF has no fillable form

fields.description: One entry per form field, in document order

label.description: Alternate (tooltip) name, present only when the form declares one

maxLength.description: Longer values are rejected by pdf_fill

type.description: text, checkbox, dropdown, radio, optionlist, or unsupported

fillTemplate.description: Field name to empty-or-current value, ready to edit and pass to pdf_fill

hasXFA.description: True for hybrid AcroForm/XFA documents, whose XFA layer is dropped when filled

truncated.description: True when the form exceeded an API enumeration cap; fields is then a prefix, not the full list

title: Inspect PDF form fields
